agentFiles.change: a new file: what agents do before they push

edits.diff:
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -8,17 +8,25 @@
   docs:
     name: rustdoc
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      id-token: write
     env:
       RUSTDOCFLAGS: -D warnings
     steps:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v5
-      - run: cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --locked
+      - uses: hushrun/hushrun/action/setup@v<version>
+      - run: hushrun run rustdoc -- env 'RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings' cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --locked
   tasks:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      id-token: write
     steps:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v5
-      - run: cargo xtask lint
-      - run: cargo xtask codegen --check
+      - uses: hushrun/hushrun/action/setup@v<version>
+      - run: hushrun run lint -- cargo xtask lint
+      - run: hushrun run codegen -- cargo xtask codegen --check
       - run: cargo xtask trace
   package:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest

--- /dev/null
+++ b/hushrun.yaml
@@ -0,0 +1,4 @@
+# hushrun.yaml: where this repository's events go.
+version: 1
+repository: github.com/acme/shop
+backend: <your org's URL, once you sign in>

commands.after: hushrun run rustdoc -- env 'RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings' cargo doc --workspace --no-deps --locked
hushrun run lint -- cargo xtask lint
hushrun run codegen -- cargo xtask codegen --check

notes: your org: connects github.com/acme/shop, so that its CI records results with its own ID token
your org: adds github.com/acme/shop to your org's dashboard, unless it is there already
hushrun.yaml: a new file: repository github.com/acme/shop, its URL on hushrun, and the key that verifies hushrun's log

suggestions.after: hushrun run trace -- cargo xtask trace
suggestions.why: it runs a task of the repository's own (cargo xtask), which can deploy or write reports: wrap it if it only runs checks

suggestions.after: hushrun run dist -- cargo xtask dist
suggestions.why: it runs a task of the repository's own (cargo xtask), which can deploy or write reports: wrap it if it only runs checks
